text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Losing today made me realize...
...I don't 
have time to be crying right now.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: A losing streak? Bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I lose, I won't 
give up.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If it's to win,
I'll lose as many times as 
it takes!
choice_data_list: Let's win twice as much as we've lost!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. First, a solid review. And 
then, thorough and meticulous fine-tuning!

choice_data_list: Y-You took the words right out of ...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, your job comes after that. ...I'm 
counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! If I lose twice,
I just 
have to win four times!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right! Now that that's settled,
there's no 
time to lose.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Reflect, apply, repeat, reflect! Let's 
head back to get ready for the next race!"
